name: Gaussian-Centric Binding
definition: A training-free strategy to associate each 3D Gaussian with relevant mesh faces by casting rays from training cameras toward the Gaussian's bounding box corners, ensuring robustness to mesh topology.
summary: Gaussian-Centric Binding is a training-free strategy that associates 3D Gaussians with a proxy mesh via ray casting, avoiding the misalignment and retraining issues of mesh-centric methods.
